other_conditions: Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Odisha.
Applicant must be a regular student of a recognized educational institution.
Applicant must not be covered by any Government of India Scholarship.
Applicant must not be receiving any other financial assistance, stipend or scholarship from the State or Central Government.

Eligibility includes students in primary (Std I‑V), middle & high school (Std VI‑X), colleges/universities, technical/vocational/professional institutes, distance education programmes, and special schools registered under the PWD Act 1995 that are not receiving grant‑in‑aid from the State/Central Government.
Scholarship continues even if the student does not pass the academic year, provided regular attendance is maintained.
benefits_summary: Provides monthly scholarships ranging from ₹400 to ₹700 for eligible disabled students in Odisha, with additional allowances for visually challenged and orthopedically handicapped students.
